policies.name: Minor and Patch Updates May Be Auto-Approved
policies.description: Dependabot minor and patch updates that pass CI + governance may be merged without a compatibility assessment.

conditions.message: Minor/patch update with green CI — auto-approve eligible.

policies.name: Major Version Upgrades Require Compatibility Assessment
policies.description: Major version upgrades require a documented compatibility assessment even if CI passes.

conditions.message: Major version upgrade requires compatibility assessment (breaking API / TS / React / Vite). Open an investigation, do not auto-merge.
